component.name: Folder Size Setup
component.summary: Show recursive folder sizes in GNOME Files

description.p: Adds a "Total Size" column to the GNOME Files list view showing the recursive size of a folder's contents — the same number the Properties window reports, instead of the built-in item count.

Sizes are measured in the background and cached, so browsing never blocks. This setup window lets you choose where that cache lives, turn the column on or off, decide what gets indexed at login, and pre-index whole drives so sizes appear instantly from the first look.

ul.li: Folder contents are only ever read, never modified.
Symbolic links are never followed, so nothing is counted twice.
There is no background service. Indexing runs once at login, after a delay and at low priority, then exits; you can switch it off.
On-disk caching can be switched off entirely.

description.p: First stable release. Folder sizes are now kept up to date by an indexing run at login, in full the first time and then only where something changed.
Measurement was made consistent: the indexer and the fallback walk now report exactly what the Properties window does, where before they could disagree about the same folder.
Indexing no longer walks filesystems it was told to skip, and drives whose names are not plain ASCII are listed correctly.
Adds a setup window, an installable desktop entry, and enables the Total Size column automatically on first run.
